# Existing Alpine runtime

`alpine.min.js` is the existing, unmodified **Alpine.js 3.14.3** CDN distribution. It matched <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.14.3/dist/cdn.min.js> byte-for-byte. This packaging change preserves the shell's referenced runtime without a version upgrade.

The accompanying MIT `LICENSE` is from the exact upstream tag: <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alpinejs/alpine/v3.14.3/LICENSE.md>. The npm distribution's `LICENSE` URL was absent, so the tagged repository license was used.

- `LICENSE`: `5f05c4925dd3edf049a70b4b403ac0dd43b20f72501d9359911ddd25d5ac657d`
